minimumPrompt: 为一家面向年轻设计师的 AI 灵感工具生成品牌系统，风格清爽、专业、有一点未来感。
expectedVisualResult: A brand system board with palette, typography mood, logo zone, graphic language, and multiple application examples.
passCriteria: The output is visibly a brand kit, not a single poster; it contains several organized brand-system areas.

minimumPrompt: 为一家名叫 Ember Cafe 的精品咖啡品牌探索 Logo，关键词是温暖、手作、城市通勤。
expectedVisualResult: A logo exploration sheet with multiple logo directions such as symbol, wordmark, badge, and recommended option.
passCriteria: At least 4 distinct logo concepts are visible and inspectable; marks are simple and not copied from famous brands.

minimumPrompt: 为一款 AI 图片协作工具生成产品官网首屏，突出多人协作、画布生成和快速出图。
expectedVisualResult: A website hero or landing page visual with product signal, CTA, feature modules, and responsive UI feel.
passCriteria: The output reads as a real web/product page, with clear hierarchy and UI layout rather than a generic poster.

minimumPrompt: 为夏季运动水杯做一张电商活动海报，主打冰感、防漏、限时 8 折，适合社媒投放。
expectedVisualResult: A commercial poster/social visual with product hero, headline zone, offer, CTA, and brand placement.
passCriteria: Product is prominent, campaign hierarchy is clear, and text zones are readable.

minimumPrompt: 为阿联酋 Noon 平台生成一张高端香氛身体乳商品图，模板用生活场景图，保留阿拉伯语/英语标题、卖点、价格和 CTA 安全区，不直接写价格。
expectedVisualResult: A Gulf-market ecommerce product visual with modest lifestyle context, product clarity, locked safe areas, and Arabic/English editable copy zones.
passCriteria: The output avoids alcohol, exposed models, religious-symbol decoration, and baked-in price/claims; it reads as a cross-border marketplace visual.

minimumPrompt: 生成一张高端无线耳机的商品摄影图，哑光黑材质，暗色背景，边缘冷光，适合新品发布。
expectedVisualResult: A polished product photography or commercial render with clear product subject, material, light, surface, and shadow.
passCriteria: The product remains inspectable, centered or intentionally composed, with realistic lighting and material cues.

minimumPrompt: 为一款智能台灯做 15 秒短视频分镜，开头强调深夜工作，结尾展示自动调光。
expectedVisualResult: A storyboard board with multiple sequential frames, hook, product reveal, benefit moment, and ending CTA.
passCriteria: Several frames appear in sequence with captions or shot notes; the result is not a single unrelated image.

minimumPrompt: 把这张图片里的背景换成干净的白色电商背景，并保持主体不变。
expectedVisualResult: An image edit result that preserves the subject while changing or cleaning the background.
passCriteria: Subject identity, proportions, and important details are preserved; background is cleaner and commercially usable.

minimumPrompt: 分析这个参考方向并生成一个更高级、更干净的版本，要求层级清楚、留白更好、视觉更统一。
expectedVisualResult: An improved visual direction that reflects analysis: better hierarchy, alignment, contrast, spacing, and style consistency.
passCriteria: The output visibly improves organization and quality rather than only producing a text report.

minimumPrompt: 为一场独立电子音乐节做一张艺术海报，核心概念是「城市夜里的低频共振」，中文主标题要能远距离读出。
expectedVisualResult: An art poster with one dominant idea, a clear compositional device, three typographic levels, and deliberate empty space.
passCriteria: The poster reads as a designed poster rather than a text overlay; one idea dominates, and the main title is legible.

minimumPrompt: 用 6 格漫画解释「为什么熬夜会让第二天决策变差」，第一格用场景提出问题。
expectedVisualResult: A six-panel comic strip with a scene-based opening, mechanism panels, and a closing takeaway panel.
passCriteria: Panel count and order are clear, character styling stays consistent across panels, and the mechanism is shown rather than captioned.

minimumPrompt: 把「租房党如何用 500 元改造厨房」做成 6 页小红书轮播，封面标题在缩略图下可读。
expectedVisualResult: A carousel cover plus inner pages sharing identical margins, title position, and footer position, with one accent colour.
passCriteria: The set reads as one series, each page carries one idea, and the cover title survives thumbnail downscaling.

minimumPrompt: 用一张信息图说明中国咖啡连锁门店三年增长，要求带单位、时间范围和清晰阅读顺序。
expectedVisualResult: An infographic with a named layout, one reading order, visible hierarchy, and units on every number.
passCriteria: The layout matches the data shape, numbers carry units, and the hierarchy makes the headline claim obvious.

minimumPrompt: 生成一款团队协作工具的桌面端看板页面，要真实内容密度，不要紫蓝渐变和玻璃拟态。
expectedVisualResult: A desktop interface mockup with realistic content density, one accent colour, and a single clear primary action.
passCriteria: It reads as a real product interface, not an AI placeholder; alignment is consistent and text is legible.

minimumPrompt: 为一篇讲「供应链牛鞭效应」的文章配一张图，画最难用文字说清的那个环节。
expectedVisualResult: An editorial illustration explaining the argument's hard-to-state moment, in one consistent visual language.
passCriteria: The image illustrates the mechanism rather than the topic noun, and stays readable at column width.

minimumPrompt: 为《2026 城市通勤报告》生成封面，标题要能在 200 像素宽下读清，并预留标题安全区。
expectedVisualResult: A cover with one focal point, one legible title treatment, and a clean reserved area for title overlay.
passCriteria: The cover still reads at thumbnail size and the reserved title area is visibly clean.

minimumPrompt: 把「Q3 增长复盘」做成 6 页幻灯片视觉，标题写成结论，数据页只放一张图加一句洞察。
expectedVisualResult: Six slide visuals sharing one master layout, with claim-style titles and one chart plus one insight on the data slide.
passCriteria: Slides share margins and title positions, each slide carries one idea, and titles read as conclusions.

minimumPrompt: 画一张用户注册到首次付费的流程图，决策分支必须带条件标签，连线尽量少交叉。
expectedVisualResult: A flowchart with one entry, one exit, consistent node shapes, orthogonal connectors, and labeled decision branches.
passCriteria: The diagram is readable at slide width, connectors are mostly crossing-free, and every decision branch is labeled.

minimumPrompt: 把参考照片（一只橘猫坐在窗台）做成毛线针织海报，加一行毛线拼出的标题 SUNNY CAT。
expectedVisualResult: A warm ivory poster with a centered knitted-wool emblem of the cat, visible stitches and loose yarn ends, plus a yarn-strand title.
passCriteria: The subject reads as handmade yarn craft rather than a filter, with clear negative space around it and no plastic or vector look.

minimumPrompt: 把参考照片（欧洲小镇街角咖啡馆）画成针管笔旅行速写，只保留咖啡馆和一棵树。
expectedVisualResult: A loose black-line sketch on off-white paper with sparse dry marker colour and lots of blank paper.
passCriteria: Lines are hand-drawn and open, colour is sparse strokes rather than washes, and at least about half the paper is blank.

minimumPrompt: 把参考照片（在京都街头的人像）做成超现实波普拼贴，巨物元素用一只巨大的招财猫。
expectedVisualResult: A black-and-white person cut-out over large flat colour blocks, with one giant lucky cat and small graduated elements with white doodles.
passCriteria: The subject is monochrome, the background is flat colour fields, exactly one giant surreal element appears, and there is no text.

minimumPrompt: 用参考照片（雪山日出）做一张照片图章档案，标题 ALPINE DAWN。
expectedVisualResult: A landscape layout with the untouched photo on the left and a warm paper panel on the right holding a ridge-shaped ink stamp and typewriter caption.
passCriteria: The photo half is unchanged, the seam is straight, the stamp echoes the subject shape, and most of the paper panel stays blank.

minimumPrompt: 把参考照片（一束郁金香）做成和纸胶带拼贴。
expectedVisualResult: Tulips rebuilt from translucent torn washi tape strips on plain paper with visible overlaps and lots of empty paper.
passCriteria: The image reads as physical tape collage with translucent overlaps and negative space, not a painted illustration.

minimumPrompt: 把参考照片（骑摩托车的人）做成高彩印刷电影海报，标题 MIDNIGHT RIDE。
expectedVisualResult: A 2:3 poster with a flat saturated background, a hard-edged posterised rider, a big golden condensed title and a tiny credit block.
passCriteria: Only 3-4 colours are used, the title is golden condensed uppercase, and no real film or actor names appear.

minimumPrompt: 把参考照片（一位女生侧脸）做成双色网点印刷海报，小标题 QUIET HOURS。
expectedVisualResult: A vertical poster where the portrait is rendered from fine halftone dots in one or two inks on warm paper with a small title.
passCriteria: The subject is made of fine dots rather than chunky game pixels, with at most two ink colours and no neon.

minimumPrompt: 用参考照片（海边的一把空椅子）做一张极简纸刊海报，标题「夏日尾声」。
expectedVisualResult: A vertical paper-textured poster with a small photo-collage focal element, lots of white space, one accent colour and a delicate title.
passCriteria: Most of the canvas is intentional white space, only one accent colour is used, and the typography looks editorial.

minimumPrompt: 小黑费力地推着一个巨大的咖啡杯往前走，标注「周一早上」。
expectedVisualResult: A small flat black character pushing a realistic oversized coffee cup on a pure white 16:9 canvas with a short Chinese label.
passCriteria: The character is flat black, the object is realistic, the action is clear, the background is pure white and the label is legible Chinese.

minimumPrompt: 为一款记账 App 设计 IP 吉祥物 Logo，角色是一只圆滚滚的小仓鼠。
expectedVisualResult: A 1:1 icon with a simple hamster mascot made of a few big shapes, two character colours on a muted solid background, peeking from a lower corner.
passCriteria: The mascot is readable at icon size, uses two colours plus background, is not centred, and has no text or frame.
